title: Expertise and Engagement
text:
Current research leadership
Director, Institute for Research on Migration and Society (IRMS), since 2024. IRMS is the hub for immigration research at Concordia University, with partners in Montreal, across Quebec and Canada, and internationally. It brings together 15 faculty members, postdoctoral researchers and research professionals working on topics such as migration pathways, the platform economy, and immigration and digital literacy.
Co-lead, Réseau québécois de la recherche en immigration, en intégration et en relations interculturelles (RQ3i), since 2024. RQ3i is a network funded by the FRQSC and developed in collaboration with Quebec’s ministère de l’Immigration, de la Francisation et de l’Intégration. It connects 39 co-researchers from 15 institutions, 25 government and non-governmental partner organizations across Quebec, and more than 150 student members. I oversee the network’s scientific direction and governance, its relations with the Government of Quebec, and its forecasting activities.
Concordia institutional lead, Bridging Divides, since 2023. This Canada First Research Excellence Fund program studies migrant integration and advanced technologies, with a focus on citizenship and civic participation, the future of work, health care and the responsible use of artificial intelligence. I lead the program at Concordia, sit on its institutional board and co-direct one of its four thematic clusters.
Contact me to learn about my other research leadership experiences (and my future plans!).



Some of the members of IRMS, having fun

title: Expertise and Engagement
text:
Policy advising and consulting
I advise and consult for public institutions and community organizations, and I take on research contracts. I have worked with Quebec’s ministère de l’Immigration, de la Francisation et de l’Intégration, the Ville de Montréal, the Musée de la civilisation and the Maison de l’innovation sociale and several non-profits.
Contact me to learn more details about my past mandates and projects.

title: Expertise and Engagement
text:
Media
I am happy to speak with journalists about my research and about immigration and politics in Canada and Quebec, in French or in English. I was named Expert Commentator of the Year at Concordia University. I have contributed to local media and to outlets such as the New York Times and CBC’s The Current, and I recently discussed Canada’s immigration debate on the IRPP’s Futureproofing Canada podcast.
Je suis disponible pour des entrevues, en français ou en anglais, sur mes recherches ainsi que sur l’immigration et la politique canadienne et québécoise.

title: Teaching and supervision
text:
I supervise doctoral and M.A. students working on immigration and public policy, from Canadian and comparative perspectives. The Department of Political Science at Concordia offers immigration-specific courses, and students join an active research community through the Institute for Research on Migration and Society (IRMS) and the Bridging Divides research program.
I also welcome inquiries from prospective postdoctoral fellows, including applicants to SSHRC, FRQSC and international competitions.
If you are interested in working with me, please write to mireille.paquet [at] concordia.ca with:

a short description of your research interests (one page is enough)
your CV and transcripts
a writing sample

En français. Je supervise des étudiantes et étudiants à la maîtrise et au doctorat, ainsi que des stagiaires postdoctoraux, qui souhaitent travailler en français. À Concordia, il est possible de rédiger son mémoire ou sa thèse en français. N’hésitez pas à m’écrire pour discuter de vos intérêts de recherche et des possibilités de financement.

title: Teaching and supervision
text:
Supervision
I currently supervise students, all funded by SSHRC, as well as M.A. students and three postdoctoral fellows. Former postdoctoral fellows I supervised now hold faculty positions at Concordia University, the Université de Montréal and Roskilde University; others work in research and in the public service.
I strongly believe that people with doctoral training are needed in all areas of society. I support my students in whichever path they choose, and I welcome applicants who already know they want to work outside academia.

title: Mireille Paquet
text:
Bonjour, welcome,
I am a political scientist and a Professor of Political Science at Concordia University in Montreal, Canada. My research focuses on immigration politics and policy, which I study in Canada, in settler states and in comparative perspective.
At Concordia, I direct the Institute for Research on Migration and Society (IRMS) and I hold the Concordia Research Chair on the Politics of Immigration. I am the co-lead of the Réseau québécois de la recherche en immigration, en intégration et en relations interculturelles (RQ3i).
I also have the privilege of being a co-lead of the CFREF Bridging Divides research program, in collaboration with researchers from Toronto Metropolitan University, the University of British Columbia, and the University of Alberta.
Don’t hesitate to reach out to discuss research, supervision or policy issues. I am at mireille.paquet [at] concordia.ca.

Je suis politologue et professeure titulaire au Département de science politique de l’Université Concordia, à Montréal. Mes recherches portent sur la politique et les politiques publiques d’immigration, que j’étudie au Canada et dans une perspective comparée.
À Concordia, je dirige l’Institut de recherche sur la migration et la société (IRMS) et je suis titulaire de la Chaire de recherche de l’Université Concordia sur la politique de l’immigration. Je codirige le Réseau québécois de la recherche en immigration, en intégration et en relations interculturelles (RQ3i).
J’ai également le privilège de codiriger le programme de recherche CFREF Bridging Divides, en collaboration avec des chercheuses et chercheurs de la Toronto Metropolitan University, de l’Université de la Colombie-Britannique et de l’Université de l’Alberta.
N’hésitez pas à me contacter pour discuter de recherche, de supervision ou encore de politiques publiques. Mon courriel est mireille.paquet [at] concordia.ca.
